description: One-call page audit, pick the kinds: accessibility, keyboard (tab order and focus issues), SEO, security headers, broken links, Core Web Vitals, unused CSS, resources (which plugin/theme/module/host slows the page), cache (is the CDN serving the new version). A summary line per kind; with save_to the full Markdown report with every finding. Read-only.

kinds.description: Default skips keyboard, css (slow, approximate), resources and cache

max_links.description: links only: cap on URLs fetched

save_to.description: Absolute path: write the full Markdown report there and return the path instead of the content

scope.description: a11y only: limit to this subtree

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

name: audit
